concepts.preferred_label: Pelvic inflammatory disease due to tubo-ovarian abscess
concepts.why: The negative HIV testing helps to rule out immunocompromised states that could lead to other types of infections, making pelvic inflammatory disease due to tubo-ovarian abscess a more likely explanation for the patient's symptoms and findings.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of purulent fluid noted upon incision of the cyst wall specifically supports the diagnosis of Tubo-ovarian abscess.
